name: Deutsches Studierendenwerk (DSW)
what: National association of all 57 Studierendenwerke. Represents them politically and publishes the yearly statistics this site uses for student numbers.

name: Arbeitsgemeinschaft Studierendenwerke NRW
what: Working group of the twelve Studierendenwerke in North Rhine-Westphalia. Publishes a joint yearly performance report.

name: Arbeitsgemeinschaft Niedersächsischer Studentenwerke
what: Represents the shared interests of Lower Saxony's Studierendenwerke towards the state government. Each one is represented by its managing director.

name: ARGE Studierendenwerke Süd-West, Arbeitsgruppe Baden-Württemberg
what: Working group of the managing directors of Baden-Württemberg's Studierendenwerke. Speaks jointly to state politics, for example with election questionnaires.
